description: provenance is read only from #-prefixed lines: a manifest carrying a provenance line as a bare data line is no list of owned paths, so ownership cannot be established and both a writing run and --check refuse it as unreadable, exit 1, the manifest left as it was

command: sed -i 's/^#@ generator /generator /' out/kdlith-manifest && cp out/kdlith-manifest before; "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace; echo "write=$?"; "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace --check; echo "check=$?"; cmp -s before out/kdlith-manifest && echo unchanged
stderr-contains: is unreadable: the path entry `generator kdlith version="
